tools.name: room_key
tools.description: Get the numbered room key for a map: a name and a few lines for each room, written for a game master to read at the table. Anyone gets the first three rooms. With a Pro code it gives every room and a d8 wandering encounter table. Pass the same type, size and seed as the map.

tools.name: vtt_file
tools.description: Get a link to the map's Universal VTT file (.dd2vtt) with walls, doors and lights already set, for Foundry, Roll20, Owlbear Rodeo and Fantasy Grounds. tools.name: list_map_types
tools.description: List what Ink & Torch can make: every map type, size and style, and which are free and which need Pro.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: With a pro_code, says if the code is good. With no code, says what Ink & Torch Pro adds, what it costs and where to get it. Nothing is bought through this tool.
